name: PHYS 2200
title: Computational Physics
description: A basic introduction to numerical and mathematical methods required for the solution of physics problems using currently available scientific software for computation and graphics.
requirement_description: PHYS 1230 or 1402Q or 1502Q or 1530 or 1602Q, any of which may be taken concurrently; MATH 2410Q, which may be taken concurrently.
